ruleDefinitions.name: Weak or Abused Passwords In CLI
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects weak passwords or often abused passwords (seen used by threat actors) via the CLI.
An example would be a threat actor creating a new user via the net command and providing the password inline

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*123456789.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*123123qwE.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Asd123\\\.aaaa.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Decryptme.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*P\\@ssw0rd\\!.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Pass8080.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*password123.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*test\\@202.*"))
